message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest of the city’s greenmarkets, drawing roughly 1 million visitors each year. The market operates Monday–Saturday (closed on Sundays) and offers a wide variety of fresh produce, meats, cheeses, baked goods, and artisanal products from local farmers and producers. Its central location in Union Square, combined with its long hours and diverse vendor mix, makes it the go‑to destination for both locals and tourists looking for high‑quality, locally sourced foods.
